name: Joyride to Hell
source:
After not talking for weeks, your girlfriend calls you late at night, distraught and panicked, asking you to meet her. All to just turn up at your house and invite you out on a late-night drive. After what she's done, you want nothing more than to turn your back on her and take your rightful leave. But you’ve never been great at standing your ground. 

Forgiveness truly is a virtue. 

It turns out there's something she's been hiding from you for a long time.  Not like you're one to talk, really.

Maybe it's time to be honest to one another, before everything crashes and burns?

Or maybe not. 

Who's to say it's not already too late?

[From [url=https://teallies.itch.io/joyride-to-hell]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
几个星期没有说话后，你的女朋友在深夜打电话给你，心烦意乱、惊慌失措，要求你见她。所有这些只是出现在你家并邀请你深夜开车出去。在她做了这些事之后，你只想转身离开她并离开。但你从来不擅长坚持自己的立场。

宽恕确实是一种美德。

原来她有件事瞒着你很久了。真的，你不像一个会说话的人。

也许是时候在一切崩溃之前彼此诚实？

或者也许不是。

谁说现在还不算太晚？

[来自[url=https://teallies.itch.io/joyride-to-hell]itch.io[/url]]
